sloka: अथ रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ।आपृष्ट्वा तौ च राजानौ जगाम उत्तर पर्वतम् ॥१-७४-१॥
transliteration: atha rātryām vyatītāyām viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ।āpṛṣṭvā tau ca rājānau jagāma uttara parvatam ॥1-74-1॥

translations.english: Night over, the great ascetic Viswamitra, profusely blessed the princes born in the race of Raghu, took leave of the two kings and set out towards the northern (Himalayas) mountains.
